def mergeSortedAux : List Int → List Int → List Int
| [], ys => ys
| xs, [] => xs
| x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
  if x ≤ y then
    let merged := mergeSortedAux xs' (y :: ys')
    x :: merged
  else
    let merged := mergeSortedAux (x :: xs') ys'
    y :: merged
